{{Estimated Date|Birth}}
== Biography ==

Robert was likely born in the 1770s - possibly in Denny, Stirlingshire, Scotland

:'''Note''': Birth date is an estimate only, based on birth of known children

Robert was a coal miner.<ref>As per Alexander's death reg</ref>

Robert married Catherine Muirhead in the mid to late 1790s, likely in Denny. [see notes]

They had children:
# [[Sneddon-665|Alexander Sneddon]] (1799-1855)
# [[Sneddon-678|Robert Sneddon]] (1801-1855)
# [[Sneddon-668|Catherine Sneddon]] (1803-)
# [[Sneddon-632|John Sneddon]] (1808-1880)

== Research Notes ==
* There are no marriages recorded in the Denny OPR from August 1786 to March 1801 - the period during which it is reasonable to assume that Robert and Catherine married.
* Son Alexander and Robert both died in 1855 - their death regs indicate that both Robert and Catherine were alive at this time. However they have not yet been found in 1841/1851 census records. No death reg found for either.
* Gaps in the baptisms recorded in the Denny OPR 1792-1798 may mean there were other children from this marriage
